sentences.text: Water in the name and style of 'Aqua Crystal RO Water' at Yergera lay-out, Raichur on the ground that she had obtained a valid licence from the Respondent No.3 NC: 2023:KHC-K:8267 to carry on the manufacture of packaged drinking water through water vending machine.

The respondent No.4 got issued notice dated 5.10.2019 to the petitioner, asking her to close the Unit or else electricity supply to the Unit would be disconnected for violation under the Food Adulteration Act.
3. Initially, the petitioner was granted interim order by this Court on 17.2.2020.
At the time of filing of the petition, the licence of the R.O plant was not produced.
The petitioner has produced the document vide memo dated 17.2.2020 and as per the licence obtained by the petitioner, the licence was valid from 14.10.2019 to 13.10.2021.

Learned counsel for the petitioner fairly submits that the petitioner has not obtained or renewed the licence thereafter from 13.10.2021 for running the R.O.
Plant.

4. Under the circumstances, this petition would not survive for consideration anymore and any order on merits would be a futile exercise for the reason that the petitioner has not renewed licence further, to question the order passed by Respondent No.4.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:8267 5.

In view of the memo of learned counsel for the petitioner and the fair submission of learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has not renewed the licence further from 13.10.2021,
this petition would not survive for consideration.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
